--- title: "Multimodal: RNA + protein (CITE-seq)" subtitle: "RNA/ADT interoperability in PBMC CITE-seq data" --- CITE-seq measures transcripts and surface proteins in the same cells. This workflow uses a PBMC dataset to combine RNA and antibody-derived tag (ADT) measurements with BiocPy, AnnData, MuData, and ggnomics. ::: {#87dfbf46 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import sys, pathlib sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("_includes").resolve())) from setup import configure_warnings, ensure_matplotlib_initialized ensure_matplotlib_initialized() configure_warnings() import numpy as np import pandas as pd import ggnomics as gg from plotnine import theme_bw, labs, theme ``` ::: ## 1. Data source ExperimentHub resource `EH7740` (`CITEVizTestDataSCE`, approximately 2,500 cells) is distributed as a multimodal `SingleCellExperiment`. With the current `experimenthub`/`rds2py` versions, its nested `int_colData` structure cannot be parsed: ::: {#0b6973ef .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from experimenthub import ExperimentHubRegistry from setup import EXPERIMENTHUB_CACHE hub = ExperimentHubRegistry(cache_dir=str(EXPERIMENTHUB_CACHE)) try: hub.load("EH7740") except Exception as exc: print(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}...") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Package 'multiassayexperiment' is not installed. RuntimeError: Failed to load R data from /home/maximiliann/.cache/ggnomics-docs/experimenthub/39284e0ebbff45269ed5ad6956a86002_pbmc-cite-seq-2500-sce.rds: Error initializing 'PyRdsParser': Error in 'RdsObject' cons... ``` ::: ::: We therefore use the Mair et al. BD Rhapsody PBMC resources `EH3534`–`EH3538`, which provide 499 RNA features, 42 ADT features, and 29,033 droplets from three main donors. The individual ExperimentHub resources are assembled by `load_pbmc_cite_seq()`. ::: {#22b626c9 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} from data import load_pbmc_cite_seq mods, note = load_pbmc_cite_seq() note ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` "EH7740 failed to load (RuntimeError: Failed to load R data from /home/maximiliann/.cache/ggnomics-docs/experimenthub/39284e0ebbff45269ed5ad6956a86002_pbmc-cite-seq-2500-sce.rds: Error initializing 'PyRdsParser': Error in 'RdsObject' constructor: failed to parse an S4 object's body\n - failed to parse a pairlist body\n - failed to parse pairlist element 'int_colData'\n - failed to parse an S4 object's body\n - failed to parse a pairlist body\n - failed to parse pairlist element 'listData'\n - failed to parse an R list body\n - failed to parse list element 2\n - failed to parse an S4 object's body\n - failed to parse a pairlist body\n - failed to parse pairlist element 'listData'\n - failed to parse an R list body\n - failed to parse list element 1\n - failed to parse an S4 object's body\n - class attribute in an S4 object should have a 'package' character attribute); using EH3534-EH3538 fallback" ``` ::: ::: ## 2. Discovering the RNA and ADT representations ::: {#c3d93515 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} rna, adt = mods["rna"], mods["adt"] rna ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = 27258 × 499 obs: 'sample_tag', 'donor', 'cartridge' var: 'RefSeq', 'Type' layers: None (.X) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#d589b28c .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} adt ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ``` AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = 27258 × 42 obs: 'sample_tag', 'donor', 'cartridge' var: 'Alternative', 'ID' layers: None (.X) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#612b5505 .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} adt.obs["donor"].value_counts() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6} ``` donor Donor2_Bulk 9150 Donor1_Bulk 8932 Donor3_Bulk 8843 Donor2_EBV 168 Donor3_EBV 113 Donor1_EBV 52 Name: count, dtype: int64 ``` ::: ::: ## 3. Validating shared cell identifiers The two cartridges reuse some numeric barcodes, so a barcode alone is not a unique cell identifier. The loader combines barcode and cartridge, verifies the correspondence between modalities, and preserves the resulting order. After assembly, the RNA and ADT observation names should match: ::: {#c87866a5 .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} (rna.obs_names == adt.obs_names).all() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7} ``` np.True_ ``` ::: ::: ## 4. Mapping RNA genes to ADT proteins Protein names do not always match their corresponding gene symbols. `adt.var["Alternative"]` provides the mapping used here: ::: {#7a180abe .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} rna_genes = set(rna.var_names) matched = [(protein, gene) for protein, gene in adt.var["Alternative"].items() if gene in rna_genes] len(matched), matched[:8] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=8} ``` (38, [('CD103', 'ITGAE'), ('CD11b', 'ITGAM'), ('CD11c', 'ITGAX'), ('CD123', 'IL3RA'), ('CD127', 'IL7R'), ('CD134', 'TNFRSF4'), ('CD137', 'TNFRSF9'), ('CD141', 'THBD')]) ``` ::: ::: ## 5. RNA QC and ADT QC ::: {#f0e317a0 .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} rna_qc = pd.DataFrame({ "n_counts": np.asarray(rna.X.sum(axis=1)).ravel(), "n_features": (rna.X > 0).sum(axis=1), "donor": rna.obs["donor"].to_numpy(), }) gg.plot_coldata(rna_qc, x="n_counts", y="n_features", color_by="donor") + theme_bw() + labs(title="RNA QC (targeted 499-gene panel)") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=9} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-10-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: `plot_adt_qc` uses isotype controls to estimate background signal. This panel contains immune markers but no annotated isotype-control antibodies, as seen from its feature names: ::: {#71209fb6 .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} sorted(adt.var_names) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=10} ``` ['CD103', 'CD11b', 'CD11c', 'CD123', 'CD127', 'CD134', 'CD137', 'CD14', 'CD141', 'CD16', 'CD161', 'CD163', 'CD183', 'CD184', 'CD19', 'CD194', 'CD196', 'CD197', 'CD1c', 'CD206', 'CD223', 'CD25', 'CD27', 'CD278', 'CD279', 'CD28', 'CD3', 'CD32', 'CD38', 'CD39', 'CD4', 'CD40', 'CD45RA', 'CD45RO', 'CD56', 'CD69', 'CD8', 'CD80', 'CD86', 'HLA-DR', 'TCRgd', 'Tim3'] ``` ::: ::: ::: {#eb0fceef .cell execution_count=11} ``` {.python .cell-code} try: gg.plot_adt_qc(adt, isotype_controls=[]) except ValueError as exc: print("ValueError:", exc) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ValueError: isotype_controls must be a non-empty list. ``` ::: ::: The function therefore cannot calculate an isotype-based QC summary for this dataset. The empty control list in the check above shows the corresponding validation error; the [API reference](../mkdocs) documents the required input. A control-free library-size check can still be drawn with `plot_coldata`: ::: {#173a0d38 .cell execution_count=12} ``` {.python .cell-code} adt_qc = pd.DataFrame({ "adt_counts": np.asarray(adt.X.sum(axis=1)).ravel(), "donor": adt.obs["donor"].to_numpy(), }) gg.plot_coldata(adt_qc, x="donor", y="adt_counts", shape="violin") + theme_bw() + labs(title="ADT library size by donor", y="Total ADT counts") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=12} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-13-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: The raw ADT counts are strongly right-skewed, so the scatter and embedding plots below use a log1p-transformed copy of the ADT modality: ::: {#a22c4e29 .cell execution_count=13} ``` {.python .cell-code} adt_log = adt.copy() adt_log.X = np.log1p(adt_log.X) ``` ::: ## 6. RNA-versus-protein scatter (MuData) ::: {#46256489 .cell execution_count=14} ``` {.python .cell-code} import mudata as mu mu.set_options(pull_on_update=False) mdata = mu.MuData({"rna": rna, "prot": adt_log}) mdata ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=14} ```{=html} 
MuData object with n_obs × n_vars = 27258 × 541
  2 modalities
    rna:	27258 × 499
      obs:	'sample_tag', 'donor', 'cartridge'
      var:	'RefSeq', 'Type'
      layers:	None
    prot:	27258 × 42
      obs:	'sample_tag', 'donor', 'cartridge'
      var:	'Alternative', 'ID'
      layers:	None
``` ::: ::: ::: {#e550bce0 .cell execution_count=15} ``` {.python .cell-code} gg.plot_bimodal_scatter(mdata, x_feature="CD3E", y_feature="CD3", x_mod="rna", y_mod="prot") + theme_bw() + labs(title="CD3E (RNA) vs. CD3 (protein)", y="log1p(CD3 ADT counts)") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=15} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-16-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: ## 7. Matched gene/protein panel ::: {#d0f09f66 .cell execution_count=16} ``` {.python .cell-code} pairs = [(gene, protein) for protein, gene in matched if protein in ("CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "CD38")] pairs ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=16} ``` [('CD38', 'CD38'), ('CD3E', 'CD3'), ('CD4', 'CD4'), ('CD8A', 'CD8')] ``` ::: ::: ::: {#bcc54576 .cell execution_count=17} ``` {.python .cell-code} panels = [ gg.plot_bimodal_scatter(mdata, x_feature=g, y_feature=p, x_mod="rna", y_mod="prot") + theme_bw() + theme(figure_size=(3, 3)) for g, p in pairs ] panels[0] | panels[1] | panels[2] | panels[3] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=17} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-18-output-1.png){width=225 height=225} ::: ::: ## 8. An embedding computed from RNA, colored by RNA and by protein The ExperimentHub bundle does not include an embedding. We calculate QC metrics, normalize the RNA counts, and run PCA and UMAP with `scranpy`, following the [single-cell workflow](single-cell-scranpy.qmd). HVG selection is omitted because this is already a targeted 499-gene panel. The processed object is cached by `run_scranpy_pipeline_on_cite_seq_rna()`. ::: {#4c00072e .cell execution_count=18} ``` {.python .cell-code} from data import run_scranpy_pipeline_on_cite_seq_rna final_rna = run_scranpy_pipeline_on_cite_seq_rna() final_rna.get_reduced_dim_names() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=18} ``` ['PCA', 'TSNE', 'UMAP'] ``` ::: ::: ::: {#1f6fa605 .cell execution_count=19} ``` {.python .cell-code} final_for_export = final_rna.set_metadata({}) adata_final, _alt = final_for_export.to_anndata() adata_final.X = adata_final.layers["counts"] # Align the ADT modality to exactly the QC-passing RNA cells (order preserved). adt_aligned = adt_log[adata_final.obs_names, :] for protein in ("CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "CD38"): adata_final.obs[f"ADT_{protein}"] = np.asarray(adt_aligned[:, protein].X).ravel() gg.plot_umap(adata_final, color="donor") + theme_bw() + labs(title="RNA-derived UMAP, colored by donor") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=19} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-20-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: ::: {#122f4005 .cell execution_count=20} ``` {.python .cell-code} gg.plot_umap(adata_final, color="CD3E", layer="counts") + theme_bw() + labs(title="Same UMAP, colored by CD3E RNA expression") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=20} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-21-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: ::: {#9add9334 .cell execution_count=21} ``` {.python .cell-code} gg.plot_umap(adata_final, color="ADT_CD3") + theme_bw() + labs(title="Same UMAP, colored by CD3 protein (ADT) abundance", colour="log1p(CD3 ADT)") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=21} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-22-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: RNA and protein measurements both highlight the CD3-high T-cell region, providing a simple visual comparison across modalities. ## 9. Composability Because both embeddings are returned as `ggplot` objects, they can be placed side by side with plotnine's composition operator: ::: {#df445d3b .cell execution_count=22} ``` {.python .cell-code} umap_rna = gg.plot_umap(adata_final, color="CD3E", layer="counts") + theme_bw() + labs(title="RNA: CD3E") umap_adt = gg.plot_umap(adata_final, color="ADT_CD3") + theme_bw() + labs(title="Protein: CD3") umap_rna | umap_adt ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=22} ![](multimodal_files/figure-html/cell-23-output-1.png){width=525 height=375} ::: ::: ## Next * [Specialized plots](specialized-plots.qmd) and the [plot gallery](plot-gallery.qmd) for everything else, including the repertoire and significance-bracket functionality.
